text: I write on my photos before printing them. First I copy the picture, then I click edit, then text and you can add or edit text and write on the photo. Changes can use font size from 8 to 96 and any color. Then I have it printed. If the printer fails, I try another available printer.

To return an online order, sign in to the store account, find the order, check whether it is delivered and still within the 30 day return window, choose the items to return, select a reason, create a return label, and schedule pickup. Opened cosmetics cannot be returned unless damaged.

Students enroll in an online course by logging into the learning portal, searching for a course, checking prerequisites and seat availability, adding the course to the cart, paying tuition, and confirming enrollment. If a prerequisite is missing, the student must request instructor approval before enrolling.
